intro: Guinea-Bissau is low-lying, with mangrove coasts and the Bijagós islands.

chapters.title: Land
text: The Bijagós Archipelago has about 88 islands where saltwater hippos and sea turtles live. The mainland is flat, cut by wide river estuaries.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Tropical, with a rainy season from June to October.

keyTerms.meaning: Where a river meets the sea.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Guinea-Bissau's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
